body: Core semantics aligned earlier (rollup and readiness share the set of open blockers; done resolves a blocker; decision: cancelled also resolves, see docs/implementation-decisions.md – differs from the rule proposed here). UI now labels the three values separately: 'Status (stored)', 'Derived from children' or 'Readiness: Waiting on a blocker' in the detail properties (with explanatory tooltip), 'Waiting on a blocker' / 'Children: …' in tree rows (text, not colour only), and readiness reasons naming the blocking/provider tickets in 'Plan & readiness'.
author: claude
